mn127:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn127:2.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi :
mn127:2.2: ‘ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandāhi.
mn127:2.3: pañcakaṅgo bhante, thapati āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
mn127:2.5: adhivāsetu kira bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ,
mn127:2.6: yena ca kira bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya,
mn127:2.7: pañcakaṅgo bhante, thapati bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā’ti.
mn127:2.8: evaṃ bhanteti kho so puriso pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca :
mn127:2.9: ‘pañcakaṅgo bhante, thapati āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandati. evaṃ ca vadeti :
mn127:2.10: ‘adhivāsetu kira bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ.
mn127:2.11: yena ca kira bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya.
mn127:2.12: pañcakaṅgo bhante, thapati bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā’ti.
mn127:3.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn127:3.2: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn127:3.3: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn127:3.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca :
mn127:4.1: idha maṃ bhante therā bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu :
mn127:4.5: yā cāyaṃ bhante, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti,
mn127:4.6: ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca? udāhu ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti?
mn127:5.1: tena hi gahapati, taññevettha paṭibhātu apannakaṃ te ito bhavissatīti.
mn127:5.3: yā cāyaṃ appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti, ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti.
mn127:6.1: yā cāyaṃ gahapati, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:6.2: tadamināpetaṃ gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:7.2: idha gahapati bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.
mn127:7.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ ….. pe….. viharati.
mn127:8.2: idha gahapati bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.4: idha pana gahapati bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.6: idha pana gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.8: idha pana gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.10: idha pana gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.12: idha pana gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
mn127:8.14: idha pana gahapati bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:8.16: iminā kho etaṃ gahapati pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
mn127:9.3: idha gahapati ekacco parittābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:9.4: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā parittābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:9.5: idha pana gahapati, ekacco appamāṇābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:9.6: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā appamāṇābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:9.7: idha pana gahapati, ekacco saṃkiliṭṭhābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:9.8: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:9.9: idha pana gahapati, ekacco parisuddhābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:9.10: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:10.1: hoti kho so gahapati, samayo, yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti. tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ hi kho paññāyati. no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
mn127:10.2: seyyathāpi gahapati, puriso sambahulāni telappadīpāni ekaṃ gharaṃ paveseyya,
mn127:10.3: tesaṃ ekaṃ gharaṃ pavesitānaṃ accinānattaṃ hi kho paññāyetha no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
mn127:10.4: evameva kho, gahapati, hoti kho so samayo, yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti, tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ hi kho paññāyati. no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
mn127:11.1: hoti kho so gahapati samayo, yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti, tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ ceva paññāyati, ābhānānattañca.
mn127:11.2: seyyathāpi gahapati, puriso tāni sambahulāni telappadīpāni tamhā gharā nīhareyya
mn127:11.3: tesaṃ tato nīharantānaṃ accinānattaṃ ceva paññāyetha ābhānānattañca.
mn127:11.4: evameva kho gahapati, hoti kho so samayo, yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti. tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattaṃ ceva paññāyati ābhānānattañca.
mn127:12.1: na kho gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ evaṃ hoti :
mn127:12.2: idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatanti vā. api ca yattha yattheva tā devatā adhivasanti tattha tattheva tā devatā abhiramanti.
mn127:12.3: seyyathāpi gahapati, makkhikānaṃ kājena vā piṭakena vā harīyamānānaṃ na evaṃ hoti :
mn127:12.4: idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatanti vā, api ca yattha yattheva tā makkhikā abhinivisanti, tattha tattheva tā makkhikā abhiramanti.
mn127:12.5: evameva kho gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ na evaṃ hoti :
mn127:12.6: idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatanti vā, api ca yattha yattheva tā devatā adhivasanti, tattha tattheva tā devatā abhiramantīti.
mn127:13.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca :
mn127:13.3: atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
mn127:13.4: yā tā bhante, devatā ābhā, sabbā tā parittābhā? udāhu santettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhāti?
mn127:13.5: tadaṅgena kho āvuso kaccāna, santi pana ettha ekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi panetthekaccā devatā appamāṇābhāti.
mn127:14.1: ko nu kho bhante anuruddha, hetu, ko paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santetthekaccā devatā parittābhā? santi panetthekaccā devatā appamāṇābhāti?
mn127:14.2: tena hāvuso kaccāna, taṃyevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
mn127:14.4: yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:14.5: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarāti?
mn127:14.6: yvāyaṃ bhante bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati
mn127:14.9: yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:14.10: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarāti?
mn127:14.11: yvāyaṃ bhante bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:14.13: taṃ kimmaññasi āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:14.14: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarāti?
mn127:14.15: yvāyaṃ bhante bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:14.17: taṃ kiṃ maññasi āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.

mn127:14.29: ayaṃ kho āvuso kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santetthekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi panetthekaccā devatā appamāṇābhāti.
mn127:15.2: atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
mn127:15.3: yāvatā bhante, devatā ābhā, sabbā tā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā? udāhu santetthekaccā devatā parisuddhābhāti?
mn127:15.4: tadaṅgena kho āvuso kaccāna, santetthekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā panetthekaccā devatā parisuddhābhāti.
mn127:16.1: ko nu kho bhante anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santetthekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi panetthekaccā devatā parisuddhābhāti.
mn127:16.2: tena hāvuso kaccāna, upamaṃ te karissāmi.
mn127:16.3: upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
mn127:16.4: seyyathāpi āvuso kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telampi aparisuddhaṃ vaṭṭipi aparisuddhā,
mn127:16.5: so telassapi aparisuddhattā vaṭṭiyāpi aparisuddhattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.6: evameva kho āvuso kaccāna, idhekacco bhikkhu saṃkiliṭṭhābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:16.7: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullampi na suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti. thinamiddhampi na susamūhataṃ hoti. uddhaccakukkuccampi na suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti.
mn127:16.8: so kāyaduṭṭhullassapi na suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassapi na susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassapi na suppaṭivinītattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.9: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:16.10: seyyathāpi āvuso kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telampi parisuddhaṃ vaṭṭipi parisuddhā,
mn127:16.11: so telassapi parisuddhattā vaṭṭiyāpi parisuddhattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.12: evameva kho āvuso kaccāna, idhekacco bhikkhu parisuddhābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn127:16.13: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullampi suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti. thinamiddhampi susamūhataṃ hoti. uddhaccakukkuccampi suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti.
mn127:16.14: so kāyaduṭṭhullassapi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassapi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassapi suppaṭivinītattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
mn127:16.15: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
mn127:16.16: ayaṃ kho āvuso kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santetthekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi panetthekaccā devatā parisuddhābhāti.
mn127:17.1: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca :
mn127:17.4: evaṃ me sutanti vā, evaṃ arahati bhavitunti vā.
mn127:17.5: atha ca pana bhante, āyasmā anuruddho ‘evampi tā devatā itipi tā devatātveva bhāsati.
mn127:17.7: addhāyasmatā anuruddhena tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbāti.
mn127:17.8: addhā kho ayaṃ āvuso kaccāna, āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā.
mn127:17.10: dīgharattaṃ kho me āvuso kaccāna, tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbāti.
mn127:18.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca :
mn127:18.3: yaṃ tvaṃ ceva taṃ saṅkhādhammaṃ pahāsi. mayañci’maṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ alatthamhā savaṇāyā’ti.
